newsitem.title: UK: European VGO slips on crude, weaker U.S. gasoline.
newsitem.headline: European VGO slips on crude, weaker U.S. gasoline.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil (VGO) prices slumped at the end of the week, hit by crude's dramatic fall and a crash in the value of U.S. gasoline, traders said.
The netback price for low sulphur VGO sold into the U.S. was around $120 fob a tonne, too low to entice much movement transatlantic.
Most European sellers were waiting to see how much German barge demand would materialise in the coming days, after the inland refiners bought in the ARA area this week.
Cargo sellers and buyers were wide apart, with one Scandinavian piece prominent and another heard moved into Canada from Spain by a trader.
